newsitem.title: USA: Penril to net $3.5 mln from Standard.
newsitem.headline: Penril to net $3.5 mln from Standard.

text.p: Penril DataComm Networks Inc said on Thursday it would receive about $3.5 million in net proceeds from a legal settlement reached with Standard Microsystems Corp.
Standard Microsystems said earlier on Thursday it would take a $4 million pre-tax charge related to the settlement.
Penril said that both companies denied the claims but decided to settle in order to avoid future expenses and risks of litigation. Penril would receive $3.5 million after legal expenses, it said.

Penril and Standard Microsystems filed claims against each other regarding rights and obligations over Penril's technology and products agreements with Sigma Network Systems, which Standard bought in December 1992.
Penril Chairman Henry Epstein said in a statement the cash proceeds would be made available to its previously-announced spin-off of Access Beyond.
Penril provides advanced modem and internetworking products via reseller and OEM channels.
